working_patterns: Combined filters work when properly structured
problematic_patterns: Direct street name queries without 'address contains' may fail
Time of day queries (morning, evening, night) don't work
Very specific intersection queries may not return results
Natural language location descriptions need conversion to coordinates
notes.recommended_radius: 0.005 degrees (~500m) for city center, 0.01 degrees (~1km) for broader areas
